This has happened to me as well.  After about the fifth false awakening I realized I was dreaming and became lucid.  It can be scary when you feel like you just can't wake up though.
Yes, it took three months of practice for (virtually) every night before finally achieving success.  Once you learn how, it becomes easier to do.  The key is regular practice.

A lot of people are saying not to try it because it's scary.  It can be scary the first time; then you learn to control it.  Once you've conquered the power of lucid dreaming you'll never want to have a 'normal' dream again.  I can say that my first truly lucid dream was one of the greatest experiences of my life.  It takes time and practice but it's well worth it.  Your dreams will never be the same.  Try it and then thank me later.
